task.task_name: Triage a personal auto collision claim
task.task_description: You handle new auto insurance claims. A policyholder reports a two-car collision at an intersection and sends in their account of what happened, vehicle details, damage photos, the other driver's contact and insurance information, and a police report number. Some details might be missing or conflicting, and there may not be a repair estimate yet. Your task is to check the claim against the policy and available records, see whether there's enough information to move it forward, flag missing documents or possible coverage issues, and send it to the right claims team. Straightforward claims can go through the usual process. Claims involving injuries, conflicting accounts, signs of possible fraud, or complicated coverage questions need specialist attention. You're getting the claim ready for an adjuster, who will make the final coverage and liability decisions.

operational_subtasks.description: Review the policyholder's account, vehicle and other-driver details, damage photos, and police report number; identify the reported facts and any apparent gaps or conflicting details.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumes one submitted claim packet with a representative set of materials; reviewing it and noting apparent discrepancies takes about 10 minutes. This is the initial information review, so later assessments reuse its findings rather than repeating it.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Retrieve policy and available claim records
operational_subtasks.description: Use the claim identifiers to locate the applicable policy and relevant records available in internal systems.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumes the policy and ordinary internal records are accessible through routine systems; locating and reviewing them takes about 6 minutes. The estimate excludes waiting for unavailable records or obtaining the police report itself.

operational_subtasks.description: Compare the reported collision facts with the applicable policy and available records to identify apparent coverage questions for the adjuster.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumes a routine personal auto policy and uses the facts and records already reviewed; incremental comparison and issue identification takes about 8 minutes. This identifies potential questions, not a final coverage determination.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Assess information sufficiency and missing items
operational_subtasks.description: Determine whether the information available is sufficient to move the claim to an adjuster, and identify missing documents or details that should be flagged, including whether a repair estimate is needed at this stage.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumes one incremental sufficiency assessment using the reviewed packet and records; deciding what is missing or needed next takes about 4 minutes. A repair estimate is not assumed to be required for every claim, and this estimate does not include contacting the policyholder to obtain items.

operational_subtasks.description: Evaluate the reviewed facts and identified coverage questions for injury involvement, conflicting accounts, possible fraud indicators, or complex coverage issues, and determine whether the claim belongs in the usual process or needs specialist attention.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumes a brief triage assessment for each claim, using existing findings rather than repeating the underlying review; this takes about 4 minutes. The estimate is for screening and referral selection, not a separate fraud investigation or resolution of disputed facts.

operational_subtasks.subtask_name: Route the claim with triage findings
operational_subtasks.description: Send the claim to the selected claims team with a concise handoff of the reported facts, potential coverage issues, missing information, and any reason for specialist attention.
operational_subtasks.effort_rationale: Assumes the destination and handoff system are known; preparing and submitting the claim with the already established flags takes about 3 minutes. This includes only the routing interaction and concise handoff, not downstream adjuster work.

parent_output_contract.completion_boundary: The available claim information and policy records have been reviewed, information gaps and potential coverage or complexity flags have been identified, and the claim has been sent to the appropriate usual-process or specialist claims team with a concise handoff for adjuster review.
scope_exclusions: Obtaining missing documents or information from the policyholder or other parties
